question: Pandit Birju Maharaj is associated with which form of dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is associated with the classical Indian dance form of **Kathak.**
 
• He is a renowned Kathak **dancer, choreographer, and instructor** from India.
 
• Kathak is a **North Indian classical dance** form that involves intricate footwork, pirouettes, and facial expressions to depict various emotions and stories.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj is the torchbearer of the **Lucknow gharana of Kathak** and has been honored with several prestigious awards for his contribution to Indian classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhau** is a semi-classical dance form from **eastern India.**

 
 
• It involves **acrobatics and martial arts.**
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi **is a classical dance form from the state of** Andhra Pradesh.**
 
 
• It involves** storytelling **and intricate footwork.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali** is a classical dance form from the southern state of** Kerala.**
 
 
• It involves elaborate makeup, costumes, and facial expressions to **depict mythological stories.**
